description: The single distribution list read by tools/ops/sync-offload-block.mjs. Every repository that should carry the canonical HEARTH offload block appears here exactly once. Adding a repository here is the whole of enrolling it; the tool reads nothing else. `repo` is an absolute path to the directory holding the file, `file` is the file name inside it, and `name` is the label used only when the tool has to create the file from scratch (heading `# AGENTS.md - <name>`). Note that lumberjacks-platform/Lumberjacks is a subdirectory of the lumberjacks-platform git repository, not a repository of its own; the tool resolves each target's git root itself.
